detail.longDescription:
avoGate is a lightweight client that provides a set of diagnostic and testing tools designed for analyzing, evaluating, and debugging Trojan-based connections.

* Important Information

avoGate does not sell or provide tunnel services. Users must configure their own servers and comply with local laws when using the app.
avoGate is a provider-agnostic client:  import configuration files from any Trojan service or your own server and connect with a single tap.

* Key Features

Ping Check — measurement of network latency to servers across various global regions.
Cloudflare Trace — analysis of traffic paths to Cloudflare servers.
Connect / Disconnect — fast connection to an encrypted channel powered by the Trojan protocol.

* Why avoGate

Trojan Protocol — a modern technology resistant to deep packet inspection and network filtering.
Network Utilities — test network behavior, identify weak points, and optimize your connection.
Full Privacy — avoGate does not collect or store any personal data.

* Built on Trojan

Trojan is a modern stealth protocol that mimics regular HTTPS traffic, making it difficult to detect. It combines the security of TLS encryption with the performance of advanced tunneling, providing an ideal balance of speed, stability, and privacy.

* Privacy First

avoGate does not keep usage logs, does not track user behavior, and never sells your data.
